notes: «جميعا عن ابن علية» converges three routes: each is a group (rule 3); the text writes the tail once after it
«قال ابن حجر حدثنا إسماعيل» names the teacher again as إسماعيل: not merged with ابن علية (rule 9); read as the tail as written, doubt noted
Aisha shows the cloak and says «قبض رسول الله»: she is the last link
